rows.note: Use this as the everyday verb for briefly putting food into a liquid or sauce.

example.english: I like to dip fries in ketchup.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 syu4 tiu4 jiu3 dim2 ke2 zap1

rows.note: Use 落 as the all-purpose verb for something going down, including a figure or rate falling slightly and the sun or a slope descending.

example.english: The temperature will dip a little tonight.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 hei3 wan1 wui5 lok6 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone leaves suddenly or makes an abrupt exit.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 sim2 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically when lowering a vehicle's headlight beam for an approaching car.

example.english: There’s a car coming, so remember to dip your headlights.
example.traditional: 對頭有車，記住轉低車頭燈。
example.jyutping: deoi3 tau4 jau5 ce1 gei3 zyu6 zyun2 dai1 ce1 tau4 dang1
